answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, and thus it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in inlet, verified in lantern, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the meadow check. The attacker spends 153 dollars and 13 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
